title.en: Transformer Empire: Pre-Training Scale, Test-Time Compute and Looped Variants
title.zhHans: Transformer 演进录：预训练规模、推理算力与循环架构

searchTitle.en: Transformer Architecture Timeline (2014–2026): From Attention to Test-Time Compute and Looped Variants
searchTitle.zhHans: Transformer 架构时间线（2014—2026）：从注意力机制到推理时计算与循环变体

searchSummary.en: From 2014–2017 attention papers and 2020 scaling laws to o1 test-time reasoning, custom TPU 8 systems, BIS remote-chip controls and 2026 looped Transformers.
searchSummary.zhHans: 从 2014—2017 年注意力论文、2020 年规模法则到 o1 推理时计算、第八代 TPU 系统、BIS 远程算力管制与 2026 年循环 Transformer。

subtitle.en: How self-attention evolved through pre-training scale, multimodal alignment, test-time compute and recurrent layer reuse
subtitle.zhHans: 自注意力机制如何历经预训练扩展、多模态对齐、推理时计算与层循环复用

abstract.en: Proposed in 2017 to replace recurrent sequence bottlenecks with parallelizable self-attention, the Transformer became the shared backbone of modern language and multimodal models. Over the next nine years, labs successively varied how compute was spent: scaling dense pre-training parameters and data (BERT, GPT-3), aligning conversational and multimodal interfaces (ChatGPT, GPT-4, GPT-4o), allocating test-time reasoning tokens (o1, GPT-5) and, by November 2026, introducing looped layer-reuse variants (Inkling 2 Mini, GLM-5.4) alongside specialized eighth-generation TPUs and remote-compute export rules.
abstract.zhHans: 2017 年提出的 Transformer 用可并行的自注意力机制替代了传统循环序列瓶颈，此后成为现代语言与多模态模型的共同骨干。在随后的九年里，研究与工程界不断调整算力的投入方式：从扩大预训练参数与语料规模（BERT、GPT-3），到对话对齐与原生多模态交互（ChatGPT、GPT-4、GPT-4o），再到分配推理时思考算力（o1、GPT-5），直至 2026 年 11 月出现层循环复用变体（Inkling 2 Mini、GLM-5.4）、第八代专用 TPU 系统及针对云端远程算力的出口管制。

title.en: Attention Mechanisms and Parallelizable Sequence Modeling
title.zhHans: 注意力机制与并行序列建模

narrative.en: In September 2014, Bahdanau, Cho and Bengio proposed joint alignment and translation to address the fixed-length encoding bottleneck in neural machine translation. Recurrent architectures nevertheless remained constrained by sequential step-by-step computation across tokens. In June 2017, Vaswani and co-authors published 'Attention Is All You Need,' replacing recurrence and convolutions entirely with self-attention so training could parallelize efficiently across accelerators.
narrative.zhHans: 2014 年 9 月，Bahdanau、Cho 与 Bengio 提出联合对齐与翻译机制，缓解了神经机器翻译中固定长度编码向量的信息瓶颈；但循环神经网络按时间步顺序计算的依赖仍限制了并行效率。2017 年 6 月，Vaswani 等人发表《Attention Is All You Need》，完全省去循环与卷积结构而仅依赖自注意力机制，使序列模型训练得以在加速器集群上高效并行。

keyInsight.en: Replacing sequential recurrence with self-attention aligned sequence modeling directly with parallel accelerator hardware.
keyInsight.zhHans: 用自注意力替代顺序循环结构，使序列建模与并行加速硬件的计算特性直接契合。

title.en: Bidirectional Pre-Training and Empirical Scaling Laws
title.zhHans: 双向预训练与实证规模法则

narrative.en: In October 2018, Devlin et al. introduced BERT, demonstrating that pre-training deep bidirectional Transformers achieved state-of-the-art results across eleven NLP benchmarks including GLUE. In January 2020, Kaplan et al. documented empirical power-law relationships linking cross-entropy loss to model size, dataset size and training compute, and in May 2020 Brown et al. presented GPT-3 to evaluate few-shot task performance at larger decoder scale without task-specific fine-tuning.
narrative.zhHans: 2018 年 10 月，Devlin 等人提出深度双向预训练模型 BERT，在包括 GLUE 在内的 11 项自然语言处理任务上刷新纪录。2020 年 1 月，Kaplan 等人系统刻画了交叉熵损失随模型规模、数据量与训练算力呈幂律下降的经验法则；同年 5 月，Brown 等人发布大规模解码器模型 GPT-3，检验了不经任务微调的少样本学习能力。

keyInsight.en: Empirical power-law scaling shifted research investment toward predictable compute and corpus expansion, though loss reductions do not guarantee downstream reliability.
keyInsight.zhHans: 幂律规模法则推动研发投入转向可预期的算力与语料扩展，但交叉熵下降本身并不自动保证下游任务的可靠性。

title.en: Conversational Alignment and Multimodal Frontier Releases
title.zhHans: 对话对齐与多模态前沿发布

narrative.en: In November 2022, OpenAI launched ChatGPT, pairing a conversational interface and alignment tuning with broad public access. In March 2023, OpenAI published its GPT-4 Technical Report describing a large-scale multimodal system accepting image and text inputs while withholding architectural parameter counts and training-compute details from public disclosure. Unverified third-party rumors about exact internal Mixture-of-Experts counts must be distinguished from what the primary report established.
narrative.zhHans: 2022 年 11 月，OpenAI 推出以对话方式交互的 ChatGPT 并向公众开放。2023 年 3 月，OpenAI 发布《GPT-4 技术报告》，介绍这一支持图像与文本输入的大规模多模态系统，但未在公开报告中披露具体参数规模与训练算力细节。编辑记录须将技术报告确认的多模态能力与外部未经证实的内部混合专家参数猜测明确区分。

keyInsight.en: Post-training alignment turned raw pre-trained models into widely used interactive products even as frontier labs curtailed architectural disclosure.
keyInsight.zhHans: 后训练对齐将预训练模型转化为大众交互产品，与此同时前沿实验室开始收紧底层架构细节的公开披露。

title.zhHans: 原生多模态交互与推理时计算

narrative.en: In May 2024, OpenAI announced GPT-4o to process text, audio, image and video combinations with lower voice response latency than prior multi-model pipelines. In September 2024, OpenAI introduced the o1 preview series, trained to spend additional inference-time compute reasoning through complex problems before responding, and in August 2025 it released GPT-5 to combine multimodal interaction and reasoning modes within one product line.
narrative.zhHans: 2024 年 5 月，OpenAI 发布支持文本、音频、图像与视频组合输入的 GPT-4o，降低了较早期串联式语音管线的响应延迟。同年 9 月，OpenAI 推出 o1 预览系列，将算力投入延伸至输出回答前的推理思考阶段；2025 年 8 月发布的 GPT-5 则进一步在同一产品线内整合多模态与推理模式。

keyInsight.en: Allocating compute at inference time added a second scaling axis alongside pre-training parameter and token budgets.
keyInsight.zhHans: 在推理阶段分配额外思考算力，在预训练参数与语料规模之外开辟了第二条算力扩展轴线。

title.en: Looped Transformers, Eighth-Gen Silicon and Remote-Compute Rules
title.zhHans: 循环 Transformer、第八代专用芯片与远程算力规制

narrative.en: November 2026 highlighted simultaneous pressure on cost, architecture and physical compute governance. Google announced eighth-generation TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max systems built for agentic workloads on November 9, and OpenAI cut GPT-6.2 Astra API token prices by 20% versus GPT-6 Astra on November 17. On November 19, the U.S. BIS enforced rule 91 FR 74970 regulating foreign data-center remote access to controlled AI chips. Within days, two labs shipped recurrent layer-reuse variants of the Transformer itself: on November 20, Thinking Machines Lab released open-weight looped MoE model Inkling 2 Mini (independently measured by Artificial Analysis at ~2.8x lower compute proxy than Qwen3.8 27B at equal Intelligence Index score, using ~38% more output tokens), and on November 23 Z.ai launched GLM-5.4, looping 28 base layers for two iterations on hosted plans while deferring open weights and benchmark tables.
narrative.zhHans: 2026 年 11 月的密集动态同时体现了推理成本优化、架构变体探索与算力地缘规制。11 月 9 日 Google 发布面向智能体工作负载的第八代 TPU 8tx 与 8i Max 系统；11 月 17 日 OpenAI 将 GPT-6.2 Astra 的 API 单价较前代下调 20%；11 月 19 日美国 BIS 实施 91 FR 74970 新规，将出口许可延伸至受控 AI 芯片的境外远程云访问。数日内，两家机构先后推出层循环复用的 Transformer 变体：Thinking Machines Lab 于 11 月 20 日开放循环 MoE 模型 Inkling 2 Mini 权重（经 Artificial Analysis 独立测得同等智能指数得分下计算代理开销较 Qwen3.8 27B 低约 2.8 倍，输出 token 多约 38%）；Z.ai 则于 11 月 23 日上线将 28 层基座循环迭代两次的 GLM-5.4 托管预览（首发暂未公布跑分表或开放权重）。

keyInsight.en: Rather than abandoning the Transformer, 2026 designs re-introduced iterative layer looping inside MoE backbones while custom silicon and export rules tightened around compute clusters.
keyInsight.zhHans: 2026 年的演进并未抛弃 Transformer，而是在稀疏骨干内部重新引入层循环迭代，同时专用算力系统与出口管制围绕算力集群同步收紧。

conclusion.en: Nine years after 'Attention Is All You Need,' the Transformer remains the dominant substrate of frontier AI not because its original 2017 recipe stayed static, but because researchers layered sparse routing, alignment tuning, test-time search and iterative layer looping onto parallelizable attention. At the same time, custom accelerator portfolios and remote-compute export controls underscore that architectural efficiency and physical compute access remain tightly coupled constraints.
conclusion.zhHans: 在《Attention Is All You Need》发表九年后，Transformer 依然构成前沿 AI 的核心底座——并非因为 2017 年的原始配方一成不变，而是因为稀疏专家路由、后训练对齐、推理时搜索与层循环迭代被不断叠加在可并行注意力骨干之上。与此同时，专用加速器迭代与远程算力出口管制也印证了架构效率探索与底层物理算力约束之间的紧密耦合。

changeLog.summary: Migrated transformer-empire to bounded v2.4 claims backed by primary papers and announcements, qualified unverified GPT-4 architecture rumors, and added Chapter 5 covering TPU 8 systems, GPT-6.2 pricing, BIS remote-compute controls, and looped Transformers (Inkling 2 Mini and GLM-5.4).
